projects.title: Live Broadcasting Platform
projects.summary: Architected a greenfield WebRTC and LiveKit platform for the production side of live sport: cameras, commentary and scoreboard graphics, feeding YouTube Live and Discord.
projects.problem: A legacy, cable-based production setup broke under tournament traffic: latency climbed with the audience, feeds dropped mid-match, and capacity had to be guessed days ahead of an event.
projects.approach: I owned system architecture and Python media orchestration, building a greenfield WebRTC and LiveKit platform with a React producer console, FastAPI orchestration, Redis caching and fault-tolerant fallback paths. The platform integrates with YouTube Live and Discord for distribution.
projects.result: 20+ camera feeds, live commentary feeds and real-time scoreboard graphics from one platform at 99.9% availability per match window, built from scratch by a team of 8.
projects.tradeoff: Designed the production platform around software orchestration while retaining third-party platforms for viewer-facing distribution and playback.

projects.title: AI-Assisted Electrical Instrumentation System (IQGeo)
projects.summary: Built spatial asset management backends and React interfaces enabling real-time mapping for 100,000+ electrical grid assets.
projects.problem: Build a robust spatial asset management platform for IQGeo to monitor, maintain and map critical electrical infrastructure in real time.
projects.approach: Designed asset-management backends in Python FastAPI and React, integrated GeoServer with MongoDB for dynamic spatial layers, and built a LangChain RAG system for network installation planning. Automated AWS infrastructure and Jenkins CI/CD.
projects.result: Enabled real-time mapping for 100,000+ grid assets, reduced map load latency by 40%, and cut network installation planning effort by 50%.

projects.title: AI-Assisted Enterprise QA Automation & Event-Driven Platform
projects.summary: Split a monolithic test runner into 11 NestJS microservices over Kafka and cut production MTTR by 40% across ~1M daily events.
projects.problem: Synchronous service-to-service calls meant one slow test runner stalled the entire QA pipeline, and a failed run stayed invisible until somebody went looking for it.
projects.approach: I decomposed the monolithic runner into 11 Kafka-based NestJS microservices: versioned event contracts, idempotent consumers, bounded retries with dead-letter queues, and OpenTelemetry carried through the event envelope. Alongside it, I integrated Keycloak for OAuth 2.0/OIDC single sign-on, automated bug tracking and Jira ticketing workflows, and built AI developer agents on MCP and Claude Code that cut new-service setup from four hours to fifteen minutes.
projects.result: 1M+ telemetry events a day, 70% lower operational latency, 40% better mean time to recovery.

projects.title: Turf Assistant — Sports & Golf Facility Management Platform
projects.summary: Handled 1M+ daily operational requests with real-time sensor and dispatch syncs at 99.95% uptime during peak facility hours.
projects.problem: Modernize end-to-end operations for sports facilities, golf courses, local maintenance contractors and agronomic consulting teams.
projects.approach: Architected Angular portals and Node.js/Express APIs over PostgreSQL, used GraphQL for dynamic operations dashboards and REST for third-party integrations, and migrated containerized services to AWS ECS via Jenkins. Built a LangChain pipeline for hardware maintenance planning.
projects.result: Handled 1M+ daily requests at 99.95% uptime during peak facility hours, improved field technician utilization by 25%, reduced deployment downtime by 80%, and cut manual scheduling overhead by 35%.

projects.title: DEVEBOL — AI-Assisted Sports Club Management Platform
projects.summary: A sports club platform with AI features.
projects.problem: Sports clubs ran rosters, schedules and member communication by hand, with no AI assistance and no reliable way to reach members in real time.
projects.approach: I built the platform on Next.js with Prisma over Supabase, added LangChain and Redis for the AI-assisted features, and wired up real-time member communication through Firebase push notifications, Twilio and SendGrid.
projects.result: Roster management, AI-assisted workflows and member notifications running on one platform instead of manual coordination.

projects.title: AFFCO — Property & Tenant Management SaaS
projects.summary: A property management SaaS with automated rent processing.
projects.problem: A real estate agency tracked properties, tenants and rent collection across spreadsheets and manual follow-up, with no automated way to process rent or notify tenants.
projects.approach: I built the property and tenant management system on Next.js and Prisma, integrated Stripe to automate rent processing, and added SendGrid and Twilio for tenant and staff notifications.
projects.result: Rent collection and tenant communication running as one automated workflow instead of spreadsheets and manual follow-up calls.

projects.title: ReadMyRhythm — Telemedicine & EKG Review Platform
projects.summary: Owned system architecture for an AI-assisted clinician platform processing 50,000 ECGs per month.
projects.problem: Enable ingestion of diagnostic ECG/EKG data from smartwatches and personal devices for cardiologist interpretation within 24 hours, while connecting users with cardiac providers.
projects.approach: Created a Next.js clinician platform with Python FastAPI file parsing and a LangChain RAG system for AI-assisted first-pass report drafting. Implemented OAuth 2.0/OIDC and secure document access with TrueVault, Supabase and short-lived signed URLs.
projects.result: Processes 50,000 ECGs per month through a secure clinician workflow.

projects.title: Incentive Management System — FIAT
projects.summary: Owned low-level design for settlement services under the lead architect and optimized a batch processing $50M+ in annual dealer incentives.
projects.problem: Optimize the enterprise sales incentive lifecycle with a multi-tier approval pipeline and a high-performance financial settlement engine.
projects.approach: Developed Java microservices and Angular dashboards, authored low-level designs for settlement services, partitioned dealer datasets and implemented set-based aggregation. Automated AWS EC2 releases via Jenkins.
projects.result: Reduced settlement batch processing from 3 hours to 40 minutes and scaled batch capacity 4x without additional cloud infrastructure costs.

projects.title: Optical Fiber Management System — Comcast
projects.summary: Owned network topology APIs and dashboard queries monitoring more than 15,000 optical fiber nodes.
projects.problem: Deliver real-time visibility, route planning and predictive maintenance across extensive optical fiber infrastructure.
projects.approach: Created Angular topology dashboards and Node.js REST services on MongoDB, then redesigned complex MongoDB aggregation pipelines for the dashboard query layer.
projects.result: Reduced query latency by more than 60%, improving affected queries from repeated 30-second timeouts to approximately 2 seconds.
